latestVersion.changelog:
Instagram Video Editor Online — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release offering AI-powered, cloud-based video editing for Instagram formats.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Users can trim clips, add text overlays, and resize videos to 9:16 for Reels.
- Simple, chat-based commands handle editing, exporting, and session management.
- Export videos in 1080p MP4 optimized for Instagram posts and Reels.
- Easy setup with anonymous token generation for quick access and up to 100 free credits.
